commission: Assess training access (X) and high productivity (Y) in this synthetic organizational population. The requested quantity is the exact descriptive difference P(Y=1|X=1) minus P(Y=1|X=0). If the requested causal effect is not uniquely identified, report not_identified without a point estimate. Positive values mean higher probability of Y under X=1.
table_meaning: Exact population probability weights, not a finite sample. Divide weights by their sum to obtain the joint population distribution. There is no sampling-error or confidence-interval question.

completed_checks: program output agrees with stated arithmetic contrast
